g.text: Everything is stored in this browser. Reset restores the original menu, tables and sample sale.
Total sales is the only large coral
figure, the headline number for the day.
Five figures at the top, 7 table
columns, and 3 task cards: each chunk
Date filter is the only control above
the table. Reset is red and far from
Summary numbers sit above the table they
summarise. Related tasks share a card.
Logout is top-right and Update capacity
is beside its inputs, each 40 to 44 px
A stats row over a sortable-style table
is the standard admin report pattern.
Changing the date refilters the table
calm rules keep dense data readable.
